weeks.title: Week 1: Fund Accounting Basics
weeks.lessonHtml:
Week 1: Fund Accounting Basics

Learning Objectives

  • Classify activities into appropriate fund types
  • Apply modified accrual to governmental funds
  • Apply full accrual to proprietary funds

Key Topics

1. Governmental funds

This topic covers essential CPA exam concepts related to Governmental funds. Understanding this material is critical for both passing the CPA exam and applying these principles in real-world CFO scenarios.

CFO Application: As a CFO, you will regularly apply Governmental funds concepts in financial reporting, strategic decision-making, and compliance with GAAP standards. This knowledge directly impacts your ability to prepare accurate financial statements and provide guidance to management.
CPA Exam Tip: Governmental funds is frequently tested on the exam. Focus on practical application, authoritative guidance citations, and computational accuracy.

2. Proprietary funds

This topic covers essential CPA exam concepts related to Proprietary funds. Understanding this material is critical for both passing the CPA exam and applying these principles in real-world CFO scenarios.

CFO Application: As a CFO, you will regularly apply Proprietary funds concepts in financial reporting, strategic decision-making, and compliance with GAAP standards. This knowledge directly impacts your ability to prepare accurate financial statements and provide guidance to management.
CPA Exam Tip: Proprietary funds is frequently tested on the exam. Focus on practical application, authoritative guidance citations, and computational accuracy.

3. Fiduciary funds

This topic covers essential CPA exam concepts related to Fiduciary funds. Understanding this material is critical for both passing the CPA exam and applying these principles in real-world CFO scenarios.

CFO Application: As a CFO, you will regularly apply Fiduciary funds concepts in financial reporting, strategic decision-making, and compliance with GAAP standards. This knowledge directly impacts your ability to prepare accurate financial statements and provide guidance to management.
CPA Exam Tip: Fiduciary funds is frequently tested on the exam. Focus on practical application, authoritative guidance citations, and computational accuracy.

4. Modified accrual vs. accrual

This topic covers essential CPA exam concepts related to Modified accrual vs. accrual. Understanding this material is critical for both passing the CPA exam and applying these principles in real-world CFO scenarios.

CFO Application: As a CFO, you will regularly apply Modified accrual vs. accrual concepts in financial reporting, strategic decision-making, and compliance with GAAP standards. This knowledge directly impacts your ability to prepare accurate financial statements and provide guidance to management.
CPA Exam Tip: Modified accrual vs. accrual is frequently tested on the exam. Focus on practical application, authoritative guidance citations, and computational accuracy.

Practice Application

Work through practice problems applying week 1: fund accounting basics concepts. These problems mirror actual CPA exam scenarios and real-world CFO challenges.

Key Takeaways

  • Master Governmental funds for exam success and professional competence
  • Master Proprietary funds for exam success and professional competence
  • Master Fiduciary funds for exam success and professional competence
  • Master Modified accrual vs. accrual for exam success and professional competence
  • Understand authoritative guidance and when to apply it
  • Practice computational problems until you can solve them efficiently
  • Connect concepts to real-world CFO responsibilities

weeks.title: Week 4: Special Topics (Pensions, Debt, Interfund)
